notes: Original source's cumulative, PTR-labelled disenchanting table, row 1/4 for item 229070 (leather feet). All four rows share ONE item-specific 81-operation denominator; do not count the rows as four cohorts, treat future snapshots as new cohorts, or assume mutual exclusivity. Table text does not identify output quality/item IDs because icons are absent from the indexed text; outputRank and outputItemID intentionally null. Source lists a 1-3 Storm Dust tooltip range on another row, but it is NOT a source-measured per-cast minimum/maximum or histogram. Row 1 output hit count is not a total material quantity. Underlying player sample dates, exact source game build, item bonus/variant, gear quality, skill/specialization and eligibility on current Retail are not verified. No current-game valuation or measured chance is inferred.
